'''Commander Braedin''' is a [[high elf]] quest giver located at the [[Silver Covenant Camp]] in the [[Thalassian Highlands]]. He is [[Vereesa Windrunner]]'s right hand man in the [[Silver Covenant]] and was placed in charge of cleansing the lands of any perils that could endanger the refugees seeking sanctuary<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|7|Wyrms of the Highlands}}</ref> and keeping watch over the blood elves' mountain stronghold of [[Felstrider Retreat]].<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|9|Felstrider Retreat (quest)|Felstrider Retreat}}</ref>

Despite his young age, Braedin carried himself with the calm weight of command and remained loyal to Vereesa through every loss and slight that the Silver Covenant endured. When [[Shalandis Isle]] was successfully taken by the Silver Covenant, he announced to Vereesa that the [[Regency Council]] awaited her in the main pavilion on the island.<ref>''[[A Good Day]]''</ref>
